usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all Ceph MDS (Metadata Server) daemons for a given cluster, including both active and standby daemons. The `cluster` path parameter is the Ceph cluster FSID, not a human-friendly name — retrieve it from the cluster list endpoint first. MDS daemons only appear in CephFS deployments; clusters without a CephFS filesystem will return an empty array.

examples.summary: List MDS daemons for a specific Ceph cluster

tips: An MDS with rank -1 and no fs_name is in standby mode and not serving any filesystem — this is normal in resilient deployments.
Check standby_replay: true to confirm hot-standby MDSes are tailing the active MDS journal for faster failover.
The direxists field reflects whether the MDS data directory is present on the hosting node; false may indicate a misconfigured or migrated daemon.
The service field indicates whether the systemd unit is enabled — an MDS can be known to the cluster (state = up:standby) yet have service: false if it was started manually.
State values 'stopped' or 'unknown' mean PDM is aware of the MDS configuration but the daemon is not currently visible to the Ceph cluster.
